name: HEXTAR
recent: Hextar Global 近期出现大股东与董事的股权变动，Hextar Holdings 在11月减持694万股，持股降至50.689%。此外，公司于10月9日公告多项企业提案（multiple proposals），但公告内文未提供细节。最新财报显示2026年第二季度净利同比下滑5.1%。
notable: Hextar Holdings 于11月减持694万股 Hextar Global 股份，持股比例降至50.689%。
公司于10月9日公告多项企业提案（multiple proposals）。
2026年第二季度净利为 RM15.12 million，同比下滑5.1%。
risks: 大股东 Hextar Holdings 及董事 Dato' Ong Soon Ho 在近期多次减持股份。
董事 Dato' Ong Soon Ho 在禁售期（closed period）内进行股份交易。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为 RM199.05 million，环比增长1.5%，同比增长12.1%；净利为 RM15.12 million，环比增长5.9%，但同比下滑5.1%，净利率为7.6%。

recent_en: Hextar Global has seen recent shareholder and director shareholding changes, with Hextar Holdings disposing 6.94 million shares in November, reducing its stake to 50.689%. The company also announced multiple proposals on 9 October, though details were not provided in the announcement text. The latest earnings show 2Q2026 net profit declined 5.1% year-on-year.
notable_en: Hextar Holdings disposed 6.94 million Hextar Global shares in November, reducing its stake to 50.689%.
The company announced multiple proposals on 9 October.
2Q2026 net profit was RM15.12 million, down 5.1% year-on-year.
risks_en: Major shareholder Hextar Holdings and director Dato' Ong Soon Ho have repeatedly disposed shares recently.
Director Dato' Ong Soon Ho traded shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was RM199.05 million, up 1.5% QoQ and 12.1% YoY; net profit was RM15.12 million, up 5.9% QoQ but down 5.1% YoY, with a net margin of 7.6%.
